school_status_notes: PK-12 school operating its own high school (Canaan Memorial High School, CMHS) plus a CTE program. Site has an Act 170 merger/CESA information page; ENSU has previously explored an interstate merger (Vermont Public). CMHS is also listed as an NHIAA (New Hampshire) athletics member.
how_found: canaanschools.org > Family Resources > 'Program of Studies for 25-26' (aptg.co short link -> Thrillshare PDF); also School Counseling > Documents > Programs of Studies folder
issues: Only the 2025-26 (FY25-26) Program of Studies is public; no 2026-27 version found on the site or by search, though 2026-27 is underway. PDF (68 pages) is CMHS-specific, has full course descriptions and a graduation requirements table (Academic Policies section, p.9) - no separate grad requirements file. Site is a JavaScript Apptegy app; links were taken from embedded page JSON. The Programs of Studies documents folder also holds 21-22 files prefixed CA_ and PHS_ that may belong to other schools - not checked.
